summary: The fixed system note for UI action outcomes now also tells the model not to announce a UI action in text before calling it, so no interim sentence stays above a refused action. System prompts of those requests change once.
howTo: Nothing to change. Prompt snapshot tests or evaluations that compare the full system prompt see one new sentence (UI_OUTCOME_SYSTEM_NOTE in glirastes/contracts). The note is sent only for requests using the outcome protocol; uiActionOutcomes: 'off' leaves it out together with the protocol.
